method:
Use the full prompt with Nano Banana Pro. Seat the figure close to the window, keep the hands relaxed in the lap and light one side of the face. Let photographs and household objects support the story without competing with the gaze. Prefer an understated expression to exaggerated distress; vertical framing is a starting suggestion from the example.

Limitations: Waiting for a son is a fictional prompt premise, not an established biography; the still image does not verify his return or moving curtains. The 85 mm phrase describes a desired look, not verified camera use. No seed, exact ratio or mandatory reference is evidenced. The 1143 × 2048 file is an X-delivered version, not the generator’s native file or a FilmLune reproduction.
